surface_name: WP Rocket, Delay JavaScript Execution and core inline scripts
title: 'wp.data is undefined' JavaScript error on pages using WP Rocket delay JS
symptoms: Uncaught TypeError from the inline wp-data-js-after script calling wp.data.use
Session replay tools flag a code error on every page view
cause: Delay and defer reorder a core inline script so it runs before the script it depends on.
fix: Dequeue the inline after-script on the front end if nothing there needs it, or exclude the dependency from delay.
apply: $strip = function () { wp_scripts()->add_data('wp-data', 'after', []); }; add_action('wp_enqueue_scripts', $strip, 9999); add_action('wp_print_footer_scripts', $strip, 1); then confirm document.getElementById('wp-data-js-after') is null
